titulo: Auxiliar en diseño de contenidos y gestión de campañas de comunicación interna e institucional
descripcion: Pasantía en Comunicación y Contenidos / Yacht Club Olivos Sobre el Yacht Club Olivos El Yacht Club Olivos (YCO) es uno de los principales clubes de vela de Argentina, con una trayectoria deportiva y social de casi un siglo, incluyendo la formación de medallistas olímpicos y campeones mundiales. En el marco de su centenario, que se celebrará el 4 de abril de 2027, el club busca desarrollar nuevos y más eficientes canales de comunicación con sus socios y con la comunidad, con especial foco en las plataformas digitales. El club está ubicado en el Puerto de Olivos, en un entorno privilegiado y con acceso directo a las aguas abiertas del Río de la Plata. Rol Auxiliar en Diseño de Contenidos y Gestión de Campañas de Comunicación Interna e Institucional La persona que se incorpore participará en la creación y gestión de contenidos para los diferentes canales de comunicación del club, acompañando la comunicación de eventos deportivos, sociales e institucionales. Perfil buscado Proactividad e iniciativa para anticipar necesidades y trabajar con distintos interlocutores de la institución. Excelente manejo del lenguaje escrito, representando adecuadamente la voz institucional del club. Capacidad para diseñar, implementar y mantener contenidos de comunicación en diferentes plataformas. Manejo intermedio de inglés. Buenas habilidades de comunicación y relaciones interpersonales. Herramientas y conocimientos Manejo de herramientas para creación y edición de contenidos gráficos, como Adobe, Canva o Affinity. Manejo de herramientas de edición audiovisual, como CapCut o iMovie. Conocimientos básicos de CRM. Manejo de Google Workspace o Microsoft Office. Se valorará experiencia con herramientas de programación de contenidos para redes sociales, como Meta Business Suite u otras plataformas de scheduling. Principales tareas Diseñar, producir y gestionar contenidos audiovisuales para la página web, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook y otros canales digitales del YCO. Diseñar y producir contenidos gráficos para afiches, folletería, circulares y cartelería. Redactar cartas, artículos y gacetillas sobre la actividad institucional y deportiva del club. Colaborar en la planificación y ejecución de campañas de comunicación interna e institucional. Generar contenidos vinculados a eventos deportivos y sociales. Modalidad de aprendizaje La práctica contará con el acompañamiento de un Tutor, un socio con experiencia profesional en las actividades a desarrollar. El Tutor será responsable del seguimiento y orientación diaria, y se realizarán reuniones mensuales para evaluar la evolución de la experiencia y realizar los ajustes necesarios al plan de aprendizaje. Jornada y modalidad Dedicación: 4 horas diarias, 5 días por semana. Horario: Flexible, a convenir según la disponibilidad académica y las necesidades de la práctica. Modalidad: Híbrida. Presencialidad: Mínimo 1 y máximo 3 días por semana en la sede del YCO, especialmente durante eventos deportivos y sociales. Teletrabajo: Entre 2 y 4 días por semana. Lugar: J. B. Alberdi 315, Olivos. Duración: Mínimo 1 año. Compensación y beneficios Asignación estímulo de acuerdo con la Ley 26.427 y su reglamentación vigente. Cobertura de salud según convenio colectivo UTEDyC. Refrigerio en el restaurante del YCO durante los días de trabajo presencial. Curso gratuito de Navegación a Vela, teórico y práctico, en la Escuela de Mayores del YCO, con clases semanales durante 6 meses. Una oportunidad para desarrollarte La posición ofrece la posibilidad de adquirir experiencia práctica en comunicación institucional, creación de contenidos, marketing digital y gestión de redes sociales, participando además en un proyecto especial vinculado al centenario del Yacht Club Olivos. titulo: Analista de Observabilidad y Operaciones TI
descripcion:
Buscamos un/a profesional que mantenga el foco en la operación segura y confiable de nuestros sistemas, con habilidades para observar, detectar y actuar ante anomalías. Valoramos la capacidad de análisis para interpretar logs y contribuir al diagnóstico de fallas, además de la disciplina operativa para seguir jobs, procesos batch y workers.
Se espera que:
  • Seas egresada o egresado de Ingeniería Informática o carrera afín, o cuentes con formación técnica equivalente.
  • Experiencia en monitoreo de infraestructura y aplicaciones en entornos cloud (Grafana, Prometheus u otras).
  • Experiencia usando Linux como sistema operativo de servidores.
  • Experiencia configurando alertas automatizadas y notificaciones push.
  • Experiencia gestionando o dando seguimiento a procesos batch y jobs programados.
  • Capacidad de definir umbrales y reglas de detección de anomalías.
  • Experiencia con herramientas de tickets/incidentes (GLPI, GitLab, Jira u otras).
  • Leer en inglés sin Google Translator ni IA.
  • Se requiere al menos 2 años de experiencia en roles similares.
También buscamos buenas habilidades de comunicación, trabajo colaborativo y orientación a la mejora continua para incrementar la visibilidad de los sistemas y reducir la recurrencia de fallas.

descripcion: Quiénes somos Acerca de Fudo Somos una compañía que combina experiencia en la industria gastronómica y pasión por la tecnología. Todos los días ayudamos a decenas de miles de restaurantes a lo largo de Latinoamérica a mejorar su servicio con nuestro software de gestión, nuestras aplicaciones móviles y nuestra plataforma de pagos. Fudo es el sistema operativo del restaurante: todo lo que un restaurante factura, cobra, compra, paga y vende pasa por nuestro sistema. Somos líderes de mercado en Argentina y Chile, con una porción muy significativa de los restaurantes de cada país trabajando con nosotros, y crecemos aceleradamente en México, Colombia y Brasil. Además de nuestro software, procesamos pagos con licencia propia en tres países. Crecemos rápido y lo hacemos de manera sustentable: financiamos nuestro crecimiento con nuestra propia operación, no con rondas de inversión. Eso nos permite tomar decisiones de largo plazo. Acerca del equipo Nuestra misión es facilitarle la vida a los restaurantes que trabajan con nosotros. Una parte central de esa propuesta de valor es que el comensal disfrute la experiencia de ordenar y reservar en ellos. Por eso lanzamos la vertical de Consumers: para enfocarnos al 100% en cómo las personas interactúan con nuestros productos y evolucionar los que hoy ya usan millones de comensales. Vas a ser parte de un equipo muy dinámico donde todos los días subimos cosas a producción. Es común empezar el día con una idea, seguir con un diseño consensuado con el equipo y terminar con esa funcionalidad en producción antes del almuerzo. Nos movemos rápido y con poca burocracia, apalancados en los procesos y sistemas de ingeniería que construimos para permitirnos esa velocidad. Automatizamos con AI todo lo repetitivo y operativo. Nos desvela encontrar formas nuevas de trabajar que nos dejen más tiempo para pensar y diseñar las arquitecturas, los flujos y las funcionalidades que le aportan valor a nuestros usuarios. Descripción del rol Buscamos un Consumers Founding Engineer: un ingeniero fuerte de backend y de mobile que quiera ser dueño técnico de nuestro producto de cara al consumidor final, de la app hasta la base de datos. Es un rol de producto tanto como de ingeniería. No hay un backlog esperándote. Hay un problema de negocio, hipótesis para validar y decisiones de scope abiertas. Vas a estar en esa conversación desde el primer día, no recibiendo el resultado. El desafío técnico es doble. Del lado mobile, construir un producto de consumo masivo: releases frecuentes, performance en dispositivos reales, notificaciones, pagos y una experiencia que se sostenga sin manual de uso. Del lado backend, apoyar ese producto en una plataforma multi-tenant diseñada para el restaurante, con todo lo que eso implica en identidad, permisos, privacidad y performance. Esperamos que te manejes con autonomía, responsabilidad y compromiso, pero siendo a la vez parte de un equipo que tracciona y trabaja en conjunto. Que seas un referente técnico y que eleves el estándar de cómo Fudo construye producto de consumo. Responsabilidades • Construir el producto de cara al consumidor de punta a punta: la app y los servicios backend que la alimentan. • Diseñar la API de cara al consumidor sobre una plataforma multi-tenant pensada para el restaurante: modelo de identidad, permisos y privacidad. • Definir el stack de cliente y sostener la decisión: qué se resuelve cross-platform, qué conviene en web embebida y qué necesita ir nativo. • Operar el ciclo de release mobile: builds, App Store y Play, feature flags, rollout gradual, crash-free rate y tiempos de arranque. • Modelar y construir la capa de datos del producto: esquemas, índices, performance de queries, e integraciones con los servicios que ya existen. • Instrumentar y medir: analytics de producto, funnels de conversión, activación y retención. Decidir la próxima iteración con datos de uso. • Trabajar el día a día con Claude Code y agentes, y definir cómo se usan bien en un producto de cara al usuario: qué se delega y qué se revisa a mano. • Traducir la visión del producto en scope entregable ciclo a ciclo. Qué esperamos de vos Requerimientos mínimos (excluyentes) • Aplicaciones mobile en producción. Excluyente. Apps publicadas y mantenidas en App Store y Play Store, con usuarios reales. Que puedas contar cómo manejabas releases, versionado, crashes y performance en dispositivos de gama baja. • Trabajo diario con agentes de código. Excluyente. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor o equivalente, incorporado a tu forma de construir. Que puedas contar qué le delegás, qué no, cómo revisás lo que produce y en qué te cambió el criterio. • Habilidades de backend sólidas: 5+ años construyendo y manteniendo servicios en producción, con criterio de diseño, testing y operación. Ruby es nuestro lenguaje preferido en el backend. • Fuerte en bases de datos: modelado relacional, SQL avanzado, índices, análisis y tuning de queries. Trabajamos con PostgreSQL. • Diseño de APIs para clientes mobile: versionado, compatibilidad hacia atrás, payloads chicos, paginación, sincronización y comportamiento con conectividad mala. • Mentalidad de producto: que puedas interactuar con otras áreas descubriendo sus problemas, planteando soluciones y evaluando la efectividad de las mismas. • Autonomía en ambigüedad: que hayas trabajado en algo donde el scope no estaba escrito y lo hayas escrito vos. Requerimientos deseables • Flutter y Dart en producción. Es nuestro stack mobile. • Experiencia en productos de cara al consumidor. Apps B2C con volumen, donde la conversión, la retención y el onboarding eran métricas tuyas y no de otro equipo. • Ruby en producción, en cualquier sabor: Rails, o stacks más chicos tipo Cuba y Sequel. • Sensibilidad de diseño: haber trabajado codo a codo con diseño y que te importe cómo se ve y cómo se siente lo que construís. • Pagos: checkout, tokenización, wallets, Apple Pay y Google Pay, y PSPs de LATAM (Mercado Pago y similares). • Capacidades nativas: push notifications, deep links, cámara y QR, mapas y geolocalización. • Criterio sobre shells híbridos: Hotwire Native, React Native o web embebida, y cuándo cada uno es la decisión correcta. • Growth y experimentación: A/B testing, feature flags, analytics de producto. • Marketplaces o productos con red de dos lados. • Experiencia en otros SaaS B2B. descripcion: About Belong We didn't build a better property management company. We replaced the need for one. Belong is the operating system for rental homeownership. One system that runs rent, maintenance, finances, residents, and visibility end to end. Not a person juggling disconnected tools. A system that gets smarter every single day, with every home we add. We've survived Covid, the tech crash, and the toughest capital markets cycle in a generation. We are growing fast, we are AI-first, and we are building something that has never existed before. Our 200+ Belongers are strong, curious, and unreasonably ambitious. If you want a passive role at a company that's okay with average, this is not it. The Role The Leasing Advisor owns the full journey from first contact to signed lease. This is not a coordination role. It is not order-taking. You close. The Growth team exists to bring homes into the Belong system and connect the right residents to the right homes fast. You are the person who makes that happen with precision and care. Every day you delay is a day a homeowner loses income and a prospective resident waits for a home they need. This is a high-ownership, high-accountability position. You will manage complex conversations, negotiate terms, navigate objections, and build real relationships with both homeowners and prospective residents. The volume is real. The pace is real. The bar is high. You will not succeed here if you wait to be told what to do. You will not succeed here if you treat this as a call center job. You will succeed if you own your pipeline, your relationships, and your outcomes without being asked. What You'll Own The Leasing Pipeline You own every lead from first inquiry to signed lease. You decide the cadence, the follow-up strategy, and the close. Nothing disappears into a void because you put it there. Homeowner and Resident Conversations You lead the high-stakes conversations. Pricing discussions, objection handling, lease terms, complex situations. You bring confidence and empathy in equal measure. You understand that behind every leasing decision is a real person with real stakes. Cross-Functional Coordination You work seamlessly with Operations, Member Experience, and Homecare to ensure every home is ready before a resident moves in. You surface blockers early. You do not let internal friction become a member problem. Pipeline Discipline and Reporting You track every lead, every follow-up, every outcome with precision. You use data to identify where deals stall and what it takes to move them forward. You surface patiterns to the Growth team so the whole system sharpens. AI-Powered Leasing Execution You use AI tools to move faster, draft smarter, and surface insights your competitors miss. You are not afraid of automation. You embrace it because it gives you more time to do what only you can do: build trust with real people. What We're Looking For On Experience • 3 or more years in sales, leasing, account management, or a related field where you were measured on outcomes • Experience in real estate, hospitality, or any environment where the member experience is the product • A track record of managing complex multi-party conversations and closing outcomes that hold • Fluency with CRM tools and a data-informed approach to your pipeline • Excellent written and verbal communication in English. The patterns you surface, the objections you hear, the friction you flag: all of it makes the system smarter and the next leasing cycle faster. You will work closely with senior leadership. You will have real ownership over your outcomes. You will see the direct impact of your work on homeowners and residents who chose Belong because someone like you made the experience worth trusting. You will be part of an AI-first company that gives you the tools to move faster, think bigger, and build skills that will define the next decade of your career. Competitive compensation. Meaningful equity. Clear growth opportunities as we scale. A team that holds a high standard and means it. The acceptance rate here is lower than Harvard's. descripcion:
Real experience building agent systems that run unattended

This is the requirement we cannot flex on. We are not looking for someone who has used AI tools, or built a chat interface over a document set. We are looking for someone who has built harnesses — a model with tools, memory and a task loop, running on a schedule, doing work without a person in the conversation. Tell us about one you built and shipped. What it did, what it got wrong, how you found out, and what you changed. We are as interested in the failure handling as in the capability.

The discipline that makes a model safe to leave running

Some of what you build here touches federally regulated processes. Getting an answer mostly right is not good enough, and neither is escalating everything and calling it safe.

What separates an automation we can trust from a demo is the scaffolding around the model, and we have strong views on it:

  • Deterministic checks bracket every model step. Validate the inputs before the model sees them, and validate the output against rules that do not involve a model. The reasoning sits in the middle, and it never certifies its own work — a verdict on correctness comes from a check the model cannot influence.
  • Missing is a failure, not a pass. An empty result, a partial record, a field that did not populate — these fail loudly. The most expensive bugs in this class of system are the ones where nothing appeared to go wrong.
  • Every output traces to the exact inputs that produced it. When a number is questioned six weeks later, you can show which records, which version of the logic, and which run produced it.
  • Confidence thresholds are explicit. What the system handles alone, what it flags for a person, and what it refuses to decide — decided deliberately and written down, not emergent.

You do not need to have used those words. You do need to have learned the lesson some other way, and to recognize why it matters more here than in most places. If your instinct on finding compliance logic in an unversioned script is that it needs fixing before it needs extending, you will do well here.

Our stack — ideally you know some of this

  • Python or Node for the pipelines. We are not precious about which
  • Agent harnesses — the orchestration layer around the model, not just the model. Claude Code and similar coding agents, especially used across a team; custom harnesses you have built yourself; anything where you have had to decide what the loop does, where it stops, and what happens when a step fails. This is the part of the stack we care most about
  • Agent frameworks and tool protocols — MCP, function calling, whatever you have used to give a model real capability
  • Browser automation — some of what we need to reach has no API
  • SQL and analytical databases — our data platform is ClickHouse
  • ERP data — SAP Business One, though you do not need to have worked in it
  • Source control and CI as habits, not as process imposed on you

descripcion: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. As we expand across Latin America, we're building our first technical team in the region. We're looking for founding engineers who want to work directly with customers, solve complex data problems, and help shape how Hilbert builds and operates in LATAM. The Mission: Architect the Ground Truth At Hilbert, we shorten "months" to "minutes." We build the AI Growth Engine that Fortune 500 enterprises and iconic B2C brands use to navigate their revenue drivers in real time. We are expanding our deployment model. Whether we're ingesting data into our high-performance ClickHouse managed warehouse or implementing Warehouse-Native logic directly within a customer's own data warehouse, such as Snowflake or BigQuery, the goal is the same: give our AI agents a perfect, high-fidelity view of the business. As a Founding Forward Deployed Data Engineer in LATAM , you'll be at the center of bringing Hilbert to new enterprise customers across the region. You'll work directly with their data and technical teams, architect deployments, solve messy integration problems, and turn what you learn in the field into better infrastructure and product. The Hard Problem: Architectural Hybridity & Semantic Clarity The challenge isn't just moving rows; it's ensuring reasoning consistency . You're responsible for making sure our AI produces the same high-quality insights regardless of where the data resides. Our Current Hurdles • The Dual-Track Challenge: We're building a system that can either pipe data into our ClickHouse stack using Dagster and Airbyte , or execute "Zero-Extract" transformations natively in the customer's warehouse. You'll need to master both worlds. • The AI Semantic Layer: For customers with custom datasets that don't fit our canonical models, you'll build the "Translator" — defining metadata and business logic so our agentic flows can understand custom data without hallucination. • Agent-Assisted Integration: We're building a Data Discovery Agent to automate the messy parts of integration. You'll prompt and partner with this agent to analyze customer data, suggest mapping alternatives, and generate the first version of pipelines automatically, dramatically reducing integration time. • Building in a New Market: As one of our first technical hires in LATAM, you'll help establish how we deploy, support, and scale Hilbert across the region. There won't always be an existing playbook — you'll help create it. Who You Are • The Pragmatic Polyglot: You're equally comfortable optimizing a ClickHouse query, writing native Snowpark or BigQuery SQL , and implementing data orchestration scripts in Python . • The Data Ontologist: You understand that AI needs more than a table; it needs context. You have the discipline to define the meaning behind the data. • The Translator: You can earn the trust of a customer's Data Architect, understand the logic behind custom tables and systems, and translate that complexity into Hilbert's reasoning engine. • The Builder: You're comfortable operating in an early-stage environment where you'll encounter problems that don't yet have established processes or solutions. • The Pilot: You're excited to use and improve AI agents that handle the heavy lifting of data discovery and pipeline scaffolding. • The Customer Partner: You're comfortable working directly with enterprise customers, including spending time on-site when necessary to get deployments right. What You'll Own • LATAM Customer Deployments: Own the technical implementation of new enterprise customers across Latin America, from initial data discovery through production deployment. • Hybrid Integration: Own the technical lifecycle of new customers, choosing and implementing the best deployment path — Managed ClickHouse or Warehouse-Native. • Accelerated Onboarding: Use Hilbert's internal Discovery Agent to create reports and suggest mappings, moving from raw customer data to a working v1 pipeline in record time. • AI Semantic Layer Construction: Architect semantic definitions for custom enterprise data, ensuring our agentic conversation engine has the ground truth it needs for every query. • Canonical Modeling: Transform diverse source data into Hilbert's unified growth models to power our ML systems. • Enterprise Deployment: Act as a lead technical resource for high-stakes enterprise implementations, ensuring our stack is performant within each customer's infrastructure. • Build the LATAM Playbook: Help define the technical processes, best practices, and operating model we'll use as our customer base and engineering team grow across the region. Language Requirements • Professional fluency in English and Spanish is required. You'll work directly with customers and internal teams in both languages. • Portuguese is a strong plus , particularly as we expand our presence in Brazil. Bonus Points • Deep experience with dbt for warehouse-native modeling. • Experience working with multiple modern data warehouse solutions and understanding their respective optimization strategies. • Experience with Semantic Layer frameworks such as Cube or MetricQL. • Background in e-commerce, retail, marketplaces, or consumer technology , with an understanding of revenue metrics, order lifecycle, LTV, CAC, and attribution. • Experience building an agentic workflow. • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on complex technical implementations. • Experience operating in an early-stage startup or building a new engineering function, market, or regional team. Location This role will start remotely as we build Hilbert's presence and establish our first LATAM hub. You'll travel regularly to work directly with customers across the region, particularly during onboarding, implementation, and key deployment milestones. As our team and customer presence grow and we establish a hub in a specific LATAM city, relocation within Latin America may be required in the future . We're looking for people who are excited about helping build that presence from the ground up and have flexibility around where the hub ultimately takes shape. You'll also collaborate closely with Hilbert teams across the US and Europe, so comfort working across time zones is important.

Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products. We chose hard problems on purpose. We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career. Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others. If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us. Jeeves is building AI into the core of its financial platform — from intelligent spend categorization and anomaly detection to LLM-powered workflows that help finance teams move faster. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer who is obsessed with building AI systems that actually work in production: reliable, observable, cost-efficient, and genuinely useful. This is not a research role. You will ship AI-powered features that process real financial data for real businesses. You'll work alongside backend engineers, data scientists, and product teams to take AI from prototype to production — and you'll help define how Jeeves builds with AI as the company scales. If you've built LLM pipelines, designed RAG architectures, operated ML systems in production, and care deeply about what happens when your AI makes a wrong call in a financial context — we want to meet you. Location : This is a full-time remote position. #LI-REMOTE What You'll Do: LLM & AI Pipeline Engineering • Design, build, and maintain production-grade LLM integration pipelines — including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, output parsing, and chain orchestration. • Develop and operate AI features within Jeeves's core financial products: spend categorization, document extraction, anomaly detection, financial Q&A, and automated reconciliation. • Implement structured output validation, fallback handling, and confidence scoring to ensure AI decisions meet reliability standards for financial use cases. • Evaluate and integrate AI frameworks and tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, HuggingFace, vector databases) and advocate for the right tool for the job. • Establish prompt versioning and evaluation practices to ensure AI outputs remain accurate and consistent as models and data evolve. Retrieval & Vector Search • Design and maintain vector search pipelines using databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector to power semantic search and RAG-based features. • Build document ingestion and chunking pipelines for Jeeves's financial data — processing invoices, receipts, policy documents, and transaction records. • Optimize retrieval quality through embedding model selection, chunk strategy, metadata filtering, and re-ranking techniques. ML Model Serving & Operations • Collaborate with data scientists to take trained ML models from experimental notebooks to production serving infrastructure. • Build and maintain model serving endpoints with appropriate latency SLOs, input validation, and output monitoring. • Implement model performance monitoring and data drift detection to ensure production models remain accurate over time. • Support model retraining workflows by designing clean data pipelines and feature engineering that can be continuously updated. Backend Integration & Reliability • Integrate AI services cleanly with Jeeves's backend microservices — designing clear API contracts, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation patterns. • Write high-quality, testable backend code in Python or Go/Node.js to power AI-integrated features. • Instrument AI components with structured logging, distributed tracing, latency dashboards, and alerting to ensure operational visibility. • Build human-in-the-loop review workflows for AI decisions that require oversight — particularly for high-value financial actions. Collaboration & Growth • Partner with Product, Backend Engineering, and Data Science to define the AI roadmap and translate requirements into reliable systems. • Contribute to a culture of quality by writing design docs, reviewing peers' AI system designs, and sharing learnings openly. • Help grow the AI engineering practice at Jeeves by establishing patterns, tooling, and best practices that the broader team can build on. Requirements: Minimum Requirements • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML systems in production. • Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications using APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Cohere in a production environment. • Experience designing and operating RAG pipelines, including chunking strategies, embedding models, and vector database integration (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar). • Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML workloads; familiarity with at least one AI orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent). • Experience with ML model serving infrastructure: REST or gRPC inference endpoints, input/output validation, latency budgeting, and monitoring. • Solid backend engineering fundamentals: REST APIs, relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), async patterns, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure). • Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, distributed tracing, and building dashboards for AI system health. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in fintech, financial services, or any regulated industry where AI reliability and auditability are critical. • Familiarity with prompt evaluation frameworks, A/B testing AI outputs, and tracking model performance degradation in production. • Experience with ML lifecycle management tools: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Vertex AI, or SageMaker. • Knowledge of real-time data streaming (Kafka, Kinesis) for event-driven AI pipelines. • Contributions to open-source AI tooling, published technical writing, or talks at AI/ML conferences. • Prior startup or scale-up experience — comfortable with ambiguity and building foundational systems from scratch.

descripcion: We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be able to work in a fast paced environment, operate gracefully under stress, effectively manage multiple assignments, be self driven, proactive and have great interpersonal and communication skills. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and maintenance of our core cybersecurity products. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions that address complex technical challenges. This role requires a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to mentor and collaborate effectively with other engineers. Role & Responsibilities • Software Development: Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, and secure software components using Go, Python, and Node.js, focusing on backend development and API design. • Technical Problem Solving: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions. • Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements, design solutions, and implement features. • Code Quality: Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code, following industry best practices and coding standards. • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced engineers, helping them grow their skills and knowledge. • Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies and trends in software development and cybersecurity, and contribute to the team's continuous learning and improvement efforts. Experience: • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong background in backend development and API design. Required Technical Skills Programming Languages: • Expert: Go (Golang) or Python • Proficient: Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), or the other language not listed as expert • Bonus: Experience with other languages relevant to backend development (e.g., Rust, Java, C#) Backend Development: • Expert: RESTful API design and development • Proficient: Web frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask for Python; Express.js for Node.js) • Bonus: Experience with GraphQL or gRPC Databases : • Proficient: SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) • Bonus: Experience with other database technologies (e.g., MySQL, Cassandra, Elasticsearch) Cloud Infrastructure: • Proficient: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) • Core services (Compute Engine, App Engine, Cloud Functions) • Storage (Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL) • Networking (VPC, Load Balancing) • Bonus: Experience with AWS or Azure, Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools DevOps & Tooling: • Proficient: Git, CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI) • Bonus: Docker, Kubernetes, configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef) Security : • Proficient: Secure coding practices, authentication/authorization, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities • Bonus: Experience with security tools (e.g., Snyk, OWASP ZAP), threat modeling, or security certifications Testing: • Proficient: Unit testing, integration testing, TDD (Test-Driven Development) • Bonus: Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks (e.g., Cypress, Selenium) or performance testing Additional Skills (Nice to have): • Message queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) • Real-time communication (e.g., WebSockets) • Caching mechanisms (e.g., Redis, Memcached) • Data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark) • Machine learning or AI fundamentals Soft Skills: • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills • Excellent communication and collaboration skills • Ability to work independently and as part of a team • Passion for learning and self-improvement About Eclypsium Eclypsium is a supply chain security platform that builds trust in every device by identifying, verifying and fortifying software, firmware and hardware throughout enterprise infrastructure. Eclypsium’s SaaS platform does this by integrating the bill of materials from suppliers and continuously monitoring to independently assess risk of each critical asset from chip to cloud, throughout the life cycle, and across enterprise ecosystems. Protecting Fortune 100 enterprises and federal agencies, Eclypsium has been named a Gartner Cool Vendor in Security Operations and Threat Intelligence. A TAG Cyber Distinguished Vendor, one of the World’s 10 Most Innovative Security Companies by Fast Company, a CNBC Upstart 100, a CB Insights Cyber Defender, and an RSAC Innovation Sandbox finalist. For more information, visit eclypsium.com . Benefits Eclypsium headquarters are located in Portland, OR with distributed remote employees and global teams in Argentina and the Bay Area. We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages and are committed to the well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits & Perks include: • Competitive compensation & startup equity, including 13th salary • Comprehensive premium health coverage for you and your family • 15 working days of paid vacation • Recognition of Argentina’s national holidays • Employee assistance program • Paid parental leave • Hybrid work • English classes during working hours • Regular events and celebrations Equal Opportunity Eclypsium is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the importance of diverse teams and value candidates of all backgrounds. descripcion: About Hilbert Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes. From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're backed by Andreessen Horowitz and co-build alongside leading AI companies. Product at Hilbert is a small, senior group at the core of the company. The people in these seats shape how Hilbert's agentic solution evolves, how our customers grow, and how we go to market. About the role This is a 0-to-1 seat with founder-level ownership. You'll take a whole surface of Hilbert and own it end-to-end — vision, roadmap, specs, ship dates, and the customer results it produces. We're stubborn about the mission and flexible on tactics, and we expect the same from you. Two things make this role different from most PM jobs. First, we're forward-deployed: you'll spend real time inside our customers' businesses — discovery, onboarding, growth reviews — and what you learn there becomes the roadmap. Second, the product is technical: what our customers buy is growth, but what we build is data and ML infrastructure with an agent on top. Your decisions will touch ingestion pipelines, model behavior, the agent, and activation platforms, working daily with software, ML/AI, and data engineers across time zones. Core Responsibilities • Own the product roadmap end-to-end: synthesize a complex problem space into clear direction, and carry it from idea to shipped product to measured business impact. • Engage directly with customers to understand their domain, uncover the highest-impact growth opportunities, and act as their trusted product advisor. • Track and prioritize customer requests across a large pool of accounts and topics, keeping trade-offs explicit and the roadmap trusted across the company. • Define success metrics for everything you ship, tying product outcomes to customer KPIs and company OKRs with numbers you can defend. • Partner day-to-day with software, ML/AI, and data engineers to scope ruthlessly, ship in weeks not quarters, and prototype yourself where it helps. Who thrives in this role • 8+ years as a product manager, including at least one product taken from zero to one — engineers or data scientists who became PMs are especially welcome. • Owner's mindset: you operate autonomously, navigate ambiguity, make sound calls without perfect information, and kill your own ideas when the evidence says so. • Strong technical foundation: comfortable with SQL, data pipelines, and warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery), able to hold your own in architecture and modeling discussions with engineers, with sound judgment on AI products — evals, non-determinism, when a model is good enough to ship. • Clear, compelling communicator who translates strategy into execution across engineering, GTM, and customer stakeholders. • Customer empathy paired with commercial instinct: you hear the problem behind the request, get creative about solving it, and know what customers will pay for. • Fluency in Spanish is required for this role. Location This role will start remotely as we build Hilbert's presence and establish our first LATAM hub. You'll travel regularly to work directly with customers across the region, particularly during onboarding, implementation, and key deployment milestones. As our team and customer presence grow and we establish a hub in a specific LATAM city, relocation within Latin America may be required in the future . We're looking for people who are excited about helping build that presence from the ground up and have flexibility around where the hub ultimately takes shape. You'll also collaborate closely with Hilbert teams across the US and Europe, so comfort working across time zones is important. Compensation Competitive salary + equity package, commensurate with experience. Performance-based bonuses tied to project milestones and customer impact. Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we'd still like to hear from you — people from underrepresented groups often rule themselves out too early.

descripcion: Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are one of the biggest Roblox studios by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 95+ full-time remote team members across the globe. Role Overview Driving Empire is one of the leading driving games on Roblox, and every update matters. You’ll think like a player, test like a creator, and partner closely with developers and artists to make sure every new feature, vehicle, and update delivers a great player experience. 🌟 If you live and breathe Roblox, notice the small details others miss, and love digging into games to find what could be better — this is your opportunity to make a huge impact on a game played by millions! What You’ll Do • Test Driving Empire in both a LIVE and QA environment across Mobile, Tablet, PC, and Console, ensuring comprehensive coverage & that issues are identified early • Reproduce and document issues with complete supporting materials (logs, screenshots, reproduction steps) • Conduct testing from a player-experience perspective, representing Brookhaven’s community voice • Collaborate with the QA Lead to create and execute comprehensive test plans which anticipate issues ahead of release • Work closely with other QA testers by communicating progress, risks, and test results clearly to ensure effective coverage across tests Who You Are • Proficient in written and spoken English communication • Experience as an active player on the Roblox platform with a strong understanding of Roblox player behaviour • Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies, issues, or things that don’t look right • Ability to clearly and concisely present complex information in an understandable way • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines • Able to remain focused and methodical when approaching repetitive or high-volume tasks • Ability to work and communicate effectively with people at all levels • Ability to work full-time (40+ hours per week) • Be 18 years of age or older Nice to Have • Previous experience working on Roblox games professionally • Prior experience working in QA Tech Stack • While experience with the following tech stack is NOT expected or necessary for candidates, please see below Voldex’s tech stack in case you are interested: • Monday.com • Google Suite • Discord Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status Permanent Voldex employees enjoy the following benefits: 💰 Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options ⛳️ Retirement benefits - company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA! 🩺 Medical, dental, and vision benefits - depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA. 🏖 Flexible PTO - vacations + Federal / Bank Holidays 🌎 Remote First - we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere 🎮 In-person get-togethers, virtual company-wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more! 🎓Professional Development - Reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further their training and growth 🎉 Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players Want to learn more about Voldex? descripcion: About the Team Netlify's Customer Success team is responsible for making sure customers get real, lasting value from the platform - from onboarding through renewal and beyond. The team works closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to help customers grow their usage, see clear outcomes, and stay engaged over time. Every motion the team runs - whether it's a renewal conversation, a feature adoption push or customer escalation - is designed to build trust and relationships that compound. This role exists because we have a growing book of SMB accounts that need a dedicated, consistent point of contact. As our Customer Success Associate, you’ll drive broad-stroke outreach and build the workflows to manage them well. You'll carry a book of 120+ accounts with roughly $2M in ARR, and your job is to make sure those customers are engaged, getting value, and set up for renewal. This is an entry-level role with real ownership from day one, and you'll have mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp into the commercial side of the work. What You'll Do • Own the day-to-day relationship for your book of accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and keeping customers informed, engaged, and successful on the platform • Contribute ideas to dashboards and workflows to track your book of business - renewal timelines, health signals, engagement levels, and expansion indicators - so nothing falls through the cracks • With guidance of leadership, drive outreach to customers ahead of renewal, lead those conversations, handle objections, and negotiate terms on flat renewals and smaller expansions, looping in Sales when a meaningful expansion opportunity emerges. • Track and forecast your renewal book on a rolling basis, proactively surfacing risks and creating plans to address them before they become problems • Use product usage data and customer outcomes to demonstrate value in renewal conversations and ongoing check-ins • Identify opportunities for feature adoption and product expansion within accounts, and flag those signals to the Sales team to build expansion pipeline • Gather and synthesize customer feedback and share it with Product and internal stakeholders to inform roadmap decisions and improve the customer experience • Work closely with senior CS teammates and your manager to develop your skills in account management, commercial negotiation, and customer communication What You'll Bring • Some experience in a customer-facing role - this could be internship work, customer service, sales support, retail, or anything that required you to build rapport and solve problems for people • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets, and a genuine interest in using that data to spot trends and make decisions • A track record of following through: when you commit to something, you close the loop • Clear written and verbal communication - you can explain things simply, listen well, and adapt your approach to different audiences • An interest in building a career in customer success, and curiosity about the commercial side of the business - including how renewals work, how contracts are structured, and how value gets communicated to customers • You’re based in the Denver, Colorado area and are comfortable working remotely while participating in occasional in-person meetings and engagement with Denver-based stakeholders. This Role is a Great Fit If • You're energized by building relationships and want to be the person customers actually look forward to hearing from • You thrive when you have ownership over a defined body of work and the freedom to figure out how to make it run better • You enjoy the process of organizing complexity - tracking multiple accounts, spotting patterns, and keeping everything moving without things slipping • You're drawn to roles where you learn by doing, and you're comfortable asking questions and taking feedback as you develop your skills • You get excited about connecting customers to features or capabilities they didn't know they needed, and seeing that translate into real adoption • You work well within a team structure and are looking for mentorship, but you also want to take real ownership rather than just support someone else's book Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you! At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. Because this role is eligible to participate in Netlify’s commission plan, our hiring range for Colorado is targeted at $69,000 - $80,000 in total on-target earnings. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

descripcion: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Strategic Supportability Operations (SSO) sits within Risk Operations and User Policy Operations. Our team is focused on protecting and advancing Stripe's business, brand, and mission by deploying industry-leading supportability solutions that instill user and partner trust in Stripe, while enabling progressive and sustainable business growth. Unlike other Risk Operations teams, SSO handles the most complex, high-stakes, and ambiguous user business cases—ones that require deep investigation, custom risk analysis, and creative problem-solving at the intersection of user experience, compliance, financial partner requirements, and Stripe's growth ambitions. What you’ll do As a Risk Operations Analyst on the Strategic Supportability Operations team, you will investigate and assess complex, gray-area user business cases that require deep risk judgment and tailored solutions. You will go beyond standard procedures to understand the full risk profile of users, develop custom recommendations, and collaborate across internal teams to drive cohesive, well-reasoned decisions. You will also play a key role in identifying patterns across individual cases to improve our processes, policies, and detection systems at scale—bridging tactical case work with strategic, systemic impact across Risk Operations. Responsibilities • Investigate complex, high-risk, and gray-area user business cases, applying deep risk knowledge to make sound, non-binary judgments • Navigate ambiguity confidently—develop custom, evidence-based solutions where standard frameworks do not fully apply • Identify and escalate systemic trends across cases, proposing scalable solutions to cross-functional stakeholders • Collaborate across Risk Operations, User Support, Risk Partnerships, Legal, Compliance, and Product to develop holistic risk mitigation strategies • Engage directly with users—in both positive and sensitive conversations—always maintaining a Users First mindset while balancing regulatory and financial partner requirements • Communicate complex risk findings clearly to internal partners, financial partners, and Stripe leadership • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of SSO processes, decision frameworks, and tooling • Build and maintain documentation, procedures, and playbooks to support team scalability and knowledge management • Identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies and recommend enhancements through a collaborative approach with stakeholders Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements • 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, fraud, financial operations, or a closely related field in a fast-moving environment • Demonstrated ability to navigate gray-area and non-binary decision-making in complex risk environments • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize multiple data sources into a coherent risk narrative • Experience collaborating cross-functionally on complex problems and driving alignment across teams with competing priorities • Ability to engage directly with users—including in difficult or sensitive conversations—with empathy, clarity, and professionalism • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex risk findings to varied audiences • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-paced, constantly evolving environments • Track record of identifying systemic problems from individual case patterns and driving process improvements • Deep empathy for entrepreneurs and businesses, and genuine motivation to solve problems that empower them • The ability and desire to challenge the status quo as a creative thinker who considers problems from a user perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented Preferred requirements • Familiarity with compliance or financial partnership relationship management • Experience with risk assessment and mitigation strategies in a fintech or payments environment • Working knowledge of data analysis and AI tools to quantify risk & inform decisions • Background in regulatory compliance within financial services • Experience developing scalable operational frameworks or playbooks in an ambiguous, high-stakes environment • Knowledge of payment processing systems and associated risks

descripcion: Quiénes somos Acerca de Fudo Somos una startup que combina experiencia en la industria gastronómica y pasión por la tecnología. Todos los días ayudamos a miles de restaurantes a lo largo de Latinoamérica a mejorar su servicio gracias a nuestro software de gestión y aplicaciones móviles. Nuestro sistema es líder en Chile y Argentina y estamos creciendo aceleradamente en México, Colombia y Brasil. Nuestro mayor propósito es hacerle la vida más fácil a los emprendedores gastronómicos brindándoles las mejores herramientas para llevar adelante sus negocios y, para eso, necesitamos investigar, lanzar productos y llegar a más usuarios de la mano de un gran equipo. Cada persona que nos conforma es crucial, por lo que priorizamos generar una cultura basada en la empatía, la transparencia, las ganas y el compromiso. Descripción del rol Buscamos cubrir la posición de Product Design Director para llevar adelante nuestro equipo de diseño de producto. Actualmente, contamos con 9 profesionales del diseño de gran talento que trabajan con agilidad y de forma colaborativa. Como nuestro primer Product Design Director, tu misión será garantizar la calidad de nuestro producto, sin perder la agilidad en el diseño, tomando como base nuestro Design System, definiciones de patrones y estándares de la industria, asegurando una plataforma consistente en todas sus verticales y de categoría world-class. Actuarás defendiendo al máximo la experiencia de usuario sin perder un enfoque sólido en nuestras métricas de negocio (retención, adopción de funciones y expansión). Este es un rol de liderazgo híbrido: llevarás adelante las contrataciones, la mentoría y la estrategia de diseño, al tiempo que te mantendrás lo suficientemente cerca de la ejecución técnica para ofrecer feedback profundo y constructivo sobre los flujos de usuario y la interfaz del producto. Acerca del equipo Creemos que un gran diseño requiere bases sólidas. Ya contamos con un pequeño equipo dedicado exclusivamente al Design System (compuesto por 2 diseñadores especialistas en sistemas de diseños y 1 content designer), que en conjunto con 6 product designers completan las 9 personas que componen hoy el equipo de Product Design. Heredarás una organización que valora profundamente la consistencia, la escala y la excelencia operativa desde el primer día. Principales tareas y responsabilidades 1. Estrategia de diseño • • Visión de producto: trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Producto e Ingeniería para definir un roadmap alineado con los objetivos de la compañía, produciendo experiencias que impacten positivamente los KPIs de negocio. • Unificar la experiencia: eliminar los silos entre los squads de producto para garantizar una experiencia de usuario cohesiva en toda la plataforma, web y mobile. • Impulsar el Design System: actuar como patrocinador ejecutivo del equipo dedicado al Design System, ayudándolo a definir y alcanzar métricas de adopción, eficiencia y ROI.. 2. Ejecución y calidad • • Elevar la calidad: establecer estándares altos para la arquitectura de UX, el diseño visual y de interacción, y el user research. • Facilitar, no solo gestionar: liderar revisiones de diseño, workshops y design critiques. No esperamos que diseñes a diario, pero sí que tengas la disposición de entrar a Figma para ayudar a un diseñador a estructurar un flujo complejo. • Diseño basado en datos: implementar frameworks de pruebas de usuario y analítica para que las decisiones de diseño estén respaldadas por el comportamiento real de los usuarios e informadas por las métricas de producto. 3. Liderazgo y escalado del equipo • • Mentoría y coaching: acompañar y hacer crecer al equipo actual de diseño de producto, incluidos los equipos de Design System y Contenido, ayudándoles a trazar trayectorias profesionales claras. • Escalar el equipo: definir necesidades de contratación, ciclos de entrevistas y procesos de onboarding para escalar el equipo de diseño de producto a la par de la empresa. • Cultura de diseño: cultivar una cultura colaborativa y de alto rendimiento, centrada en el aprendizaje continuo, la crítica constructiva y la empatía con el usuario. Requisitos excluyentes • Formación académica: título universitario en diseño o carreras afines. • Experiencia: más de 7 años de experiencia en diseño de producto, con al menos 2 o 3 años gestionando y escalando directamente equipos de diseño en entornos SaaS B2B o B2C de ritmo acelerado. • Dominio del entorno SaaS: entender profundamente cómo afecta el diseño a los flujos de trabajo complejos, el onboarding de usuarios, la retención, el time-to-value y la reducción del churn). • Mentalidad de liderazgo y ejecución(Player-Coach): destacar en la estrategia de negocio de alto nivel pero no has perdido el amor por la práctica del diseño. Saber cuándo delegar y cuándo guiar. • Experiencia cross-functional: trayectoria demostrada en la construcción de relaciones estrechas y colaborativas con líderes de las áreas de Producto e Ingeniería. Saber tanto acerca de APIs y las métricas de negocio como de perfiles de usuario y patrones de navegación. • Liderazgo con pensamiento sistémico: experiencia gestionando o colaborando estrechamente con roles especializados (Sistemas de Diseño, Diseño de Contenido / UX Writing) para impulsar la consistencia de la UI/UX en toda la plataforma. • Portafolio: un portafolio sólido que demuestre calidad visual, pensamiento sistémico complejo, procesos estructurados de UX y ejemplos claros de cómo tu liderazgo impulsó resultados de negocio medibles. • Herramientas y tecnología: no sólo dominio avanzado de Figma, sino también de uso de la IA, de cómo aprovecharla al máximo para agilizar el proceso de diseño, sin perder calidad ni identidad de marca Te ofrecemos • Alto impacto y gran proyección: Somos el sistema de gestión para restaurantes de mayor presencia en la región, estando presente en gran parte de los países más grandes de Latinoamérica. Con mentalidad de startup y en etapa de escalar, tendrás la oportunidad de sumarte a una compañía protagonista, participando en la evolución de la propuesta de valor a gran escala. • Salarios competitivos internacionalmente. • Opciones en la modalidad de contratación. • Cobertura de salud dependiendo de la modalidad. • Trabajo remoto, presencial o mixto. Contamos con oficinas en Ciudad de Buenos Aires. • Feriados locales de AR + día de cumpleaños libre + días hábiles de vacaciones. • Capacitación Inglés / Portugués in company. • Cobertura de Wellhub, para que entrenes cuando y donde sea. • Beneficios adicionales por partnerships con otras empresas.

descripcion: Quienes somos Acerca de Fudo Somos una startup que combina experiencia en la industria gastronómica y pasión por la tecnología. Todos los días ayudamos a miles de restaurantes a lo largo de Latinoamérica a mejorar su servicio gracias a nuestro software de gestión y aplicaciones móviles. Nuestro sistema es líder en Chile y Argentina, y estamos creciendo aceleradamente en México, Colombia y Brasil. Nuestro mayor propósito es hacerle la vida más fácil a los emprendedores gastronómicos brindándoles las mejores herramientas para llevar adelante sus negocios y, para eso, necesitamos investigar, lanzar productos y llegar a más usuarios de la mano de un gran equipo. Cada persona que nos conforma es crucial, por lo que priorizamos generar una cultura basada en la empatía, la transparencia, las ganas y el compromiso. Acerca del equipo El equipo de Core Experience es un equipo multidisciplinario y dinámico que está compuesto por personas de IT, Producto y UX. Como parte de este squad, estarás participando en mantener y desarrollar nuevas funcionalidades para que los camareros, personal de barra o encargados/admins puedan mejorar su gestión del día a día, a través del manejo de mesas, control de stock, gestión financiera, entre otras funcionalidades. Descripción del rol La persona que ocupe el rol de Team Lead Software Engineer será responsable de liderar al equipo de Software Engineers que componen el squad de trabajo. Será el enlace clave con áreas como Producto y UX. Sus responsabilidades incluyen la gestión de proyectos, la resolución de obstáculos técnicos complejos y la implementación de las mejores prácticas de calidad, tales como CI/CD, testing y revisiones de código. Responsabilidades • Gestión del equipo: Supervisar el trabajo diario, establecer roles y responsabilidades claras para cada miembro del equipo. • Desarrollo profesional: Proporcionar mentoría técnica a los miembros del equipo del stack tecnológico utilizado en Fudo. Brindar feedback efectivo para ayudar con el plan de desarrollo de cada una de las personas. • Comunicación: Coordinar entre departamentos y transmitir requisitos técnicos entre backend y frontend. • Gestión de proyectos: Supervisar cronogramas y entregables, asegurando la correcta integración entre componentes del stack. • Resolución de problemas: Proporcionar soluciones a obstáculos técnicos complejos en todo el stack tecnológico. • Mejora continua: Implementar mejores prácticas para el desarrollo de nuevas features, incluyendo CI/CD y testing. • Revisión de código: Participar activamente como code-reviewer, asegurando estándares de calidad en Ruby, React • Participación hands-on: involucrarse directamente en el desarrollo de las iniciativas del equipo, escribiendo código de backend y frontend para llevar adelante y destrabar el trabajo del ciclo. • Innovación tecnológica: Estar actualizado frente a nuevas tendencias tecnológicas y pensar en cómo se podrían integrar a nuestro ecosistema. Qué esperamos de vos Requerimientos mínimos • Tengas al menos 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo web full-stack, con experiencia comprobable tanto en frontend (JavaScript, React/Angular) como en backend (idealmente Ruby/Rails). • Manejes con soltura el diseño y consumo de APIs REST (peticiones HTTP, autenticación) y el trabajo con bases de datos (modelado, estructuras y tablas relacionales). • Conozcas de optimización de performance frontend: tooling/build (Webpack, Vite, code splitting), navegador (browser caching, HTTP/2) y assets (compresión de imágenes, lazy loading). • Cuentes con experiencia liderando equipos, o haciendo mentoring y coacheo a miembros del equipo. • Seas detallista en cuestiones de UX/UI para asegurar la calidad del producto entregado. • Te sientas muy cómodo con Git y Linux. Beneficios • Ser protagonista dentro del equipo de tecnología, impulsando mejoras, aprendiendo constantemente de un equipo de trabajo multidisciplinario orientado a objetivos. • Salarios y beneficios competitivos internacionalmente. • Trabajo remoto o semi-presencial en ambiente distendido y cómodo en nuestras oficinas de Buenos Aires. • Feriados locales + día de cumpleaños libre + días hábiles de vacaciones + día de aniversario • Capacitación Inglés / Portugués in company • Cobertura de plan de Wellhub (ex Gympass) para que utilices en gimnasios o realices algún tipo de actividad física • Beneficios adicionales por partnerships con otras empresas
